Justification: A read of R4 is materialized on this source-operand bus with full temporal information preservation and an observable route.

Name: dbg_reg_din
Structural Path: r4 -> register-file read mux/reg_dest -> dbg_reg_din -> dbg_0.mem_data -> dbg_0.mem_data_rd -> dbg_uart_txd
Attack Scenarios: During a legal debug read of R4, dbg_reg_din carries the complete register value into the debug data register and the subsequent UART response.
Justification: The incremental-MI evidence is weak (0.0) because correlated downstream debug candidates already represent the payload. SecID retains dbg_reg_din because its UOP observability is 1.0 and the RTL gives it a direct R4-derived debug-read path.

Name: dbg_0.mem_data_rd
Structural Path: r4 -> dbg_reg_din -> dbg_0.mem_data -> dbg_0.mem_data_rd -> dbg_0.dbg_dout -> UART serializer -> dbg_uart_txd
Attack Scenarios: A legal MEM_DATA debug-register read gates the R4-derived debug data through mem_data_rd into the UART response payload.
Justification: The incremental-MI evidence is weak (0.0) because it is redundant with the adjacent mem_data payload representation. SecID retains mem_data_rd because it directly gates that R4-derived payload into dbg_dout and has a valid UART observation witness.

Name: dbg_0.dbg_dout
Structural Path: r4 -> dbg_reg_din -> dbg_0.mem_data -> dbg_0.mem_data_rd -> dbg_0.dbg_dout -> UART serializer
Attack Scenarios: During a legal debug read of R4, dbg_dout contains the complete 16-bit response payload immediately before it is loaded into the debug UART serializer.
Justification: Restored by mechanism-led review: dbg_dout is the canonical debug-response boundary and directly carries mem_data_rd into the UART. Lack of phase-3 scoring is not contradictory evidence.

Name: dbg_0.dbg_uart_0.xfer_buf
Structural Path: dbg_0.dbg_dout -> UART frame construction -> dbg_0.dbg_uart_0.xfer_buf -> dbg_uart_txd
Attack Scenarios: When dbg_rd_rdy is asserted, xfer_buf captures both bytes of the R4-derived dbg_dout payload and serializes them bit by bit onto dbg_uart_txd.
Justification: Restored because xfer_buf is the persistent serializer state loaded directly from dbg_dout and is the immediate source of the untrusted UART output.
